explain.de: Startet den Computer in einer Minute neu. Viele Probleme verschwinden danach. Bitte vorher alles speichern.
explain.en: Restarts the computer in one minute. Many problems go away after a restart. Please save your work first.

actions.backupNote: No data is affected. The user is asked to save open work first.

explain.de: Schaut nach, ob Windows Sicherungspunkte für das System anlegt und welche es gibt. Ändert nichts.
explain.en: Checks whether Windows keeps restore points and lists them. Changes nothing.

explain.de: Schaltet den Computerschutz für Laufwerk C: ein, damit Windows Wiederherstellungspunkte anlegen kann. Belegt höchstens etwa 5 % des Speicherplatzes.
explain.en: Turns on System Protection for drive C: so Windows can keep restore points. Uses at most about 5 % of the disk.

actions.detect: [pscustomobject]@{ SystemDriveProtected = Test-PnhSystemProtection }
actions.backup:
$vol = Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_Volume -Filter ("DriveLetter='" + $env:SystemDrive + "'")
$ss = @(Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_ShadowStorage -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Volume.DeviceID -eq $vol.DeviceID })
Write-PnhStateJson -InputObject ([pscustomobject]@{ ProtectedBefore = (Test-PnhSystemProtection); ShadowMaxBytes = $(if ($ss.Count) { $ss[0].MaxSpace } else { $null }) }) -Path (Join-Path $Backup 'state.json')
actions.rollbackNote: Deliberately none: turning System Protection off would delete all restore points.
actions.experimentalReason: Verification uses the undocumented SPP registry value.

explain.de: Legt einen Sicherungspunkt an, zu dem Windows später zurückkehren kann. Ihre Dateien bleiben unberührt.
explain.en: Creates a restore point that Windows can go back to later. Your files are not touched.

actions.run:
$r = New-PnhRestorePoint -Description ('Plug''n''Heal ' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm')) -RunFolder $PnhRunFolder
[pscustomobject]@{ Created = $r.Created; Reason = $r.Reason }
actions.backupNote: The action is itself the backup.
actions.rollbackNote: Only adds a restore point; Windows removes old ones itself when the reserved space is full.

title.de: Computer auf einen früheren Stand zurücksetzen
title.en: Roll the computer back to an earlier state

explain.de: Setzt Windows auf einen gespeicherten früheren Stand zurück. Ihre Dateien bleiben, aber später installierte Programme und Treiber verschwinden. Der Computer startet dabei neu.
explain.en: Takes Windows back to an earlier saved state. Your files stay, but programs and drivers installed since then are removed. The computer restarts.

description.de: Nummer des Wiederherstellungspunkts aus der Liste
description.en: Restore point number from the list

actions.run: Restore-Computer -RestorePoint ([int]$P.Sequence) -Confirm:$false
actions.backupNote: Windows creates an undo restore point before restoring (not in safe mode).
actions.rollbackNote: System Restore (rstrui.exe) offers "Undo System Restore" afterwards (not after a restore in safe mode).
actions.experimentalReason: Verification via restore point type 6 is not confirmed on a test device.

explain.de: Prüft Schritt für Schritt, ob der Computer den Router, das Internet und die Namensauflösung erreicht. Ändert nichts.
explain.en: Checks step by step whether the computer reaches the router, the internet and name lookup (DNS). Changes nothing.

actions.run:
$gw = Get-PnhDefaultGateway
$dnsSrv = @(Get-DnsClientServerAddress -AddressFamily IPv4 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.ServerAddresses } | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty ServerAddresses)
[pscustomobject]@{
    Gateway      = $gw
    Loopback     = (Test-PnhPing -Target '127.0.0.1').Result
    PingGateway  = $(if ($gw) { (Test-PnhPing -Target $gw).Result } else { 'NO_GATEWAY' })
    PingInternet = (Test-PnhPing -Target '1.1.1.1').Result
    DnsServer    = $(if ($dnsSrv) { $dnsSrv[0] } else { $null })
    Dns          = $(if ($dnsSrv) { (Test-PnhDns -Server $dnsSrv[0]).Result } else { 'NO_SERVER' })
    Tcp443       = (Test-PnhTcp -Target '1.1.1.1' -Port 443).Result
}

explain.de: Findet heraus, ob die Netzwerktechnik von Windows, die Netzwerkkarte oder ein Filter auf dem Computer die Verbindung blockiert. Ändert nichts.
explain.en: Finds out whether Windows networking, the network adapter or a filter on this computer blocks the connection. Changes nothing.

title.en: Turn a disabled network adapter back on

explain.de: Schaltet eine Netzwerkkarte wieder ein, die in Windows ausgeschaltet wurde.
explain.en: Turns a network adapter back on that was switched off in Windows.

description.de: Name der Netzwerkkarte aus der Erkennung

actions.detect: Get-NetAdapter -Physical -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { "$($_.Status)" -eq 'Disabled' } | Select-Object Name, InterfaceDescription, @{ n = 'Status'; e = { "$($_.Status)" } }
actions.run: Enable-NetAdapter -Name $P.AdapterName -Confirm:$false

explain.de: Schaltet die Netzwerkkarte kurz aus und wieder ein. Die Verbindung ist dabei einige Sekunden weg.
explain.en: Switches the network adapter off and on again. The connection drops for a few seconds.

description.de: Name der Netzwerkkarte aus der Erkennung

actions.detect: Get-NetAdapter -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { "$($_.Status)" -ne 'Disabled' } | Select-Object Name, InterfaceDescription, @{ n = 'Status'; e = { "$($_.Status)" } }, LinkSpeed
actions.run: Restart-NetAdapter -Name $P.AdapterName -Confirm:$false
actions.backupNote: No setting is changed.
actions.rollbackNote: Not needed: the adapter is in the same state as before, only reconnected.

title.en: Get a new IP address from the router

explain.de: Bittet den Router um eine neue Adresse für diesen Computer. Hilft, wenn der Computer keine gültige Adresse hat.
explain.en: Asks the router for a new address for this computer. Helps when the computer has no valid address.

description.de: Name der Netzwerkkarte aus der Erkennung

actions.run:
[void](Invoke-PnhNative -FilePath 'ipconfig.exe' -ArgumentList @('/release', $P.AdapterName))
$r = Invoke-PnhNative -FilePath 'ipconfig.exe' -ArgumentList @('/renew', $P.AdapterName)
$r.ExitCode
actions.backupNote: No fixed setting is affected (adapters using DHCP only).
actions.rollbackNote: Not needed: the adapter gets an address automatically again.

explain.de: Leert die Liste der gemerkten Internet-Adressen (DNS-Cache). Windows füllt sie danach von selbst neu.
explain.en: Clears the list of remembered internet addresses (DNS cache). Windows refills it on its own.

actions.detect: [pscustomobject]@{ CacheEntries = @(Get-DnsClientCache -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Count }
actions.run: Clear-DnsClientCache
actions.rollbackNote: Not needed: the cache refills itself.

explain.de: Entfernt fest eingetragene DNS-Server und nimmt wieder die vom Router. Die alten Einträge werden vorher gesichert.
explain.en: Removes manually set DNS servers and uses the ones from the router again. The old entries are saved first.

description.de: Name der Netzwerkkarte aus der Erkennung

actions.backup:
Backup-PnhIpConfig -Destination $Backup
$a = Get-NetAdapter -Name $P.AdapterName
$k4 = "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters\Interfaces\$($a.InterfaceGuid)"
$k6 = "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip6\Parameters\Interfaces\$($a.InterfaceGuid)"
Write-PnhStateJson -InputObject ([pscustomobject]@{
        Adapter     = $a.Name
        NameServer  = (Get-ItemProperty -Path $k4 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).NameServer
        NameServer6 = (Get-ItemProperty -Path $k6 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).NameServer
    }) -Path (Join-Path $Backup 'dns.json')
actions.run:
if (Test-PnhManagedDevice) { throw 'Managed device: fixed DNS servers are probably intended; not changing them' }
Set-DnsClientServerAddress -InterfaceAlias $P.AdapterName -ResetServerAddresses

explain.de: Speichert die aktuellen Netzwerk-Einstellungen auf der Notfall-SSD, damit sie sich zurückholen lassen. Ändert nichts am Computer.
explain.en: Saves the current network settings to the rescue drive so they can be restored. Changes nothing on the computer.

actions.run: Backup-PnhIpConfig -Destination $Backup

explain.de: Setzt einen Teil der Netzwerktechnik von Windows auf den Werkszustand. Programme wie VPNs müssen danach eventuell neu eingerichtet werden. Danach ist ein Neustart nötig.
explain.en: Resets part of Windows networking (Winsock) to factory defaults. Programs such as VPNs may need to be set up again. A restart is needed afterwards.

actions.run:
$r = Invoke-PnhNative -FilePath 'netsh.exe' -ArgumentList @('winsock', 'reset')
if (-not $r.Ok) { throw ('netsh winsock reset exit code ' + $r.ExitCode) }

explain.de: Setzt die Internet-Einstellungen von Windows auf den Werkszustand. Fest eingetragene Adressen werden gesichert und lassen sich zurückspielen. Danach ist ein Neustart nötig.
explain.en: Resets the Windows internet settings (TCP/IP) to factory defaults. Fixed addresses are saved and can be restored. A restart is needed afterwards.

actions.run:
$r = Invoke-PnhNative -FilePath 'netsh.exe' -ArgumentList @('int', 'ip', 'reset', (Join-Path $Backup 'netsh-int-ip-reset.log'))
$r.ExitCode

explain.de: Spielt fest eingetragene Adressen, Routen und DNS-Server aus der letzten Sicherung zurück, zum Beispiel nach dem Zurücksetzen von TCP/IP.
explain.en: Restores fixed addresses, routes and DNS servers from the latest backup, for example after a TCP/IP reset.

actions.backup:
$src = Find-PnhLatestBackup -RunFolder $PnhRunFolder -ActionId 'net.reset_tcpip', 'net.backup_ip_config', 'net.dns_auto' -File 'ip-config.json' -Before $PnhStart
if (-not $src) { throw 'No earlier network backup found' }
Write-PnhStateJson -InputObject ([pscustomobject]@{ Source = $src }) -Path (Join-Path $Backup 'source.json')
Backup-PnhIpConfig -Destination $Backup
actions.run:
$src = (Read-PnhStateJson -Path (Join-Path $Backup 'source.json')).Source
Restore-PnhIpConfig -Source $src

explain.de: Schaltet einen eingetragenen Proxy oder ein Proxy-Skript für Ihr Benutzerkonto aus. Danach den Browser neu starten.
explain.en: Turns off a configured proxy or proxy script for your user account. Restart the browser afterwards.

actions.run:
$pol = @(Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Internet Settings', 'HKLM:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Internet Settings' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
if ($pol.Count -or (Test-PnhManagedDevice)) { throw 'The proxy is set by policy or the device is managed; not changing it' }
$k = 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Internet Settings'
Set-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name ProxyEnable -Value 0 -Type DWord
Remove-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name AutoConfigURL -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

explain.de: Entfernt einen Proxy, den Windows-Dienste wie Windows Update verwenden. Oft ein Überbleibsel von alter Software.
explain.en: Removes a proxy used by Windows services such as Windows Update. Often a leftover from old software.

actions.detect: [pscustomobject]@{ WinHttp = Get-PnhWinHttpProxyState; Managed = (Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_ComputerSystem).PartOfDomain }

title.en: Reset the hosts file to the default

explain.de: Setzt die hosts-Datei auf den Inhalt von Microsoft zurück. Diese Datei kann Webseiten umleiten oder sperren. Die alte Datei wird gesichert.
explain.en: Resets the hosts file to Microsoft's default. This file can redirect or block websites. The old file is saved.

actions.run:
$h = Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'System32\drivers\etc\hosts'
$default = @(
    '# Copyright (c) 1993-2009 Microsoft Corp.',
    '#',
    '# This is a sample HOSTS file used by Microsoft TCP/IP for Windows.',
    '#',
    '# This file contains the mappings of IP addresses to host names. Each',
    '# entry should be kept on an individual line. The IP address should',
    '# be placed in the first column followed by the corresponding host name.',
    '# The IP address and the host name should be separated by at least one',
    '# space.',
    '#',
    '# Additionally, comments (such as these) may be inserted on individual',
    '# lines or following the machine name denoted by a ''#'' symbol.',
    '#',
    '# For example:',
    '#',
    '#      102.54.94.97     rhino.acme.com          # source server',
    '#       38.25.63.10     x.acme.com              # x client host',
    '',
    '# localhost name resolution is handled within DNS itself.',
    '#	127.0.0.1       localhost',
    '#	::1             localhost'
)
Set-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $h -Name IsReadOnly -Value $false
Set-Content -LiteralPath $h -Value $default -Encoding ASCII
Clear-DnsClientCache

explain.de: Zeigt, ob die Windows-Firewall eingeschaltet ist und ob sie ausgehende Verbindungen sperrt. Ändert nichts.
explain.en: Shows whether Windows Firewall is on and whether it blocks outgoing connections. Changes nothing.

actions.run:
$blockOut = @(Get-NetFirewallRule -PolicyStore ActiveStore -Direction Outbound -Action Block -Enabled True -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
[pscustomobject]@{
    Profiles           = @(Get-NetFirewallProfile -PolicyStore ActiveStore | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{ Name = "$($_.Name)"; Enabled = "$($_.Enabled)"; In = "$($_.DefaultInboundAction)"; Out = "$($_.DefaultOutboundAction)" } })
    OutboundBlockRules = $blockOut.Count
    OutboundBlockNames = @($blockOut | Select-Object -First 15 | ForEach-Object { $_.DisplayName })
    Services           = @(Get-Service -Name mpssvc, BFE -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { "$($_.Name)=$($_.Status)" })
    OtherFirewalls     = @(Get-CimInstance -Namespace 'root/SecurityCenter2' -ClassName FirewallProduct -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { $_.displayName })
    ActiveProfiles     = @(Get-NetConnectionProfile -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { "$($_.InterfaceAlias)=$($_.NetworkCategory)" })
}

explain.de: Schaltet die Windows-Firewall wieder ein, wenn sie aus ist und kein anderes Schutzprogramm diese Aufgabe übernimmt.
explain.en: Turns Windows Firewall back on when it is off and no other security program does this job.

actions.run: Set-NetFirewallProfile -Profile Domain, Private, Public -Enabled True
actions.rollbackNote: Deliberately none: it would switch protection off again. A professional can import the saved firewall.wfw with 'netsh advfirewall import'.

title.en: Find out which filter drops network traffic

explain.de: Liest aus Windows, welcher Filter Netzwerkpakete verwirft und zu welchem Programm er gehört. Ändert nichts.
explain.en: Reads from Windows which filter drops network packets and which program it belongs to. Changes nothing.

actions.run:
$ev = Join-Path $Backup 'wfp-netevents.xml'
$fl = Join-Path $Backup 'wfp-filters.xml'
$st = Join-Path $Backup 'wfp-state.xml'
$gw = Get-PnhDefaultGateway
if ($gw) { [void](Test-PnhPing -Target $gw) }
[void](Test-PnhTcp -Target '1.1.1.1' -Port 443)
[void](Invoke-PnhNative -FilePath 'netsh.exe' -ArgumentList @('wfp', 'show', 'netevents', ('file=' + $ev)))
[void](Invoke-PnhNative -FilePath 'netsh.exe' -ArgumentList @('wfp', 'show', 'filters', ('file=' + $fl)))
[void](Invoke-PnhNative -FilePath 'netsh.exe' -ArgumentList @('wfp', 'show', 'state', ('file=' + $st)))
Get-PnhWfpDrop -NetEventsFile $ev -FiltersFile $fl -StateFile $st | Select-Object -First 15
actions.experimentalReason: XML paths of the netsh wfp dumps are not confirmed on a test device.

explain.de: Schaltet für wenige Sekunden eine Protokollierung blockierter Verbindungen ein und stellt danach den alten Zustand wieder her.
explain.en: Turns on logging of blocked connections for a few seconds, then restores the previous setting.

actions.verify:
$after = Join-Path $Backup 'auditpol-after.csv'
[void](Invoke-PnhNative -FilePath 'auditpol.exe' -ArgumentList @('/backup', ('/file:' + $after)))
$hdr = 'Machine', 'Target', 'Sub', 'Guid', 'Incl', 'Excl', 'Value'
$a = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $Backup 'auditpol.csv') | Select-Object -Skip 1 | ConvertFrom-Csv -Header $hdr
$b = Get-Content -LiteralPath $after | Select-Object -Skip 1 | ConvertFrom-Csv -Header $hdr
$same = $true
foreach ($g in '{0CCE9225-69AE-11D9-BED3-505054503030}', '{0CCE9226-69AE-11D9-BED3-505054503030}') {
    $x = @($a | Where-Object { $_.Guid -eq $g }) | Select-Object -First 1
    $y = @($b | Where-Object { $_.Guid -eq $g }) | Select-Object -First 1
    if ("$($x.Value)" -ne "$($y.Value)") { $same = $false }
}
$same
actions.experimentalReason: CSV columns of auditpol /backup are not confirmed on a test device.

title.de: Prüfen, ob die Firma das Gerät vom Netz getrennt hat
title.en: Check whether the organization isolated this device

explain.de: Prüft, ob die Organisation, die diesen Computer schützt (Microsoft Defender for Endpoint), ihn vom Netz getrennt hat. Ändert nichts.
explain.en: Checks whether the organization that protects this computer (Microsoft Defender for Endpoint) has cut it off from the network. Changes nothing.

explain.de: Zeigt VPN-Verbindungen, VPN-Netzwerkkarten und Einstellungen, die VPN-Programme hinterlassen haben. Ändert nichts.
explain.en: Shows VPN connections, VPN network adapters and settings left behind by VPN programs. Changes nothing.

actions.run:
$rx = Get-PnhVpnPattern
[pscustomobject]@{
    Connections        = @(@(Get-VpnConnection -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) + @(Get-VpnConnection -AllUserConnection -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) | Where-Object { $_ } | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{ Name = $_.Name; Status = "$($_.ConnectionStatus)"; Server = $_.ServerAddress } })
    VirtualAdapters    = @(Get-NetAdapter -IncludeHidden -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.InterfaceDescription -match $rx -or $_.Name -match $rx } | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{ Name = $_.Name; Description = $_.InterfaceDescription; Status = "$($_.Status)" } })
    SplitDefaultRoutes = @(Get-NetRoute -DestinationPrefix '0.0.0.0/1', '128.0.0.0/1' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { "$($_.DestinationPrefix) via $($_.NextHop) on $($_.InterfaceAlias)" })
    DefaultRoutes      = @(Get-NetRoute -DestinationPrefix '0.0.0.0/0' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { "$($_.NextHop) on $($_.InterfaceAlias) metric $($_.RouteMetric + $_.InterfaceMetric)" })
    NrptRules          = @(Get-DnsClientNrptPolicy -Effective -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { "$($_.Namespace) -> $($_.NameServers -join ',')" })
    VpnServices        = @(Get-Service -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.DisplayName -match $rx } | ForEach-Object { "$($_.Name)=$($_.Status)" })
    NdisFilters        = @(Get-NetAdapterBinding -AllBindings -IncludeHidden -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Enabled -and $_.ComponentID -notlike 'ms_*' } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty DisplayName -Unique)
}

actions.backup: Write-PnhStateJson -InputObject @(Get-Service -Name wuauserv, BITS, CryptSvc | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{ Name = $_.Name; StartType = "$($_.StartType)" } }) -Path (Join-Path $Backup 'starttypes.json')

title.de: Zeigen, was Platz auf C: belegt
title.en: Show what uses space on C:

explain.de: Misst, wie viel Platz temporäre Dateien, Update-Reste, Papierkorb und Downloads belegen. Ändert nichts.
explain.en: Measures how much space temporary files, update leftovers, the Recycle Bin and Downloads use. Changes nothing.

actions.run:
$sys = $env:SystemDrive
$vol = Get-Volume -DriveLetter $sys.TrimEnd(':')
$dumps = (Get-PnhSizeMB -Path (Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'Minidump')) + (Get-PnhSizeMB -Path (Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'LiveKernelReports'))
$memDmp = Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'MEMORY.DMP'
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $memDmp) { $dumps += [math]::Round((Get-Item -LiteralPath $memDmp -Force).Length / 1MB, 0) }
$hib = Join-Path $sys 'hiberfil.sys'
[pscustomobject]@{
    FreeGB                 = [math]::Round($vol.SizeRemaining / 1GB, 1)
    SizeGB                 = [math]::Round($vol.Size / 1GB, 1)
    UserTempMB             = Get-PnhSizeMB -Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath())
    WindowsTempMB          = Get-PnhSizeMB -Path (Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'Temp')
    WuDownloadMB           = Get-PnhSizeMB -Path (Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'SoftwareDistribution\Download')
    DeliveryOptimizationMB = Get-PnhSizeMB -Path (Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'ServiceProfiles\NetworkService\AppData\Local\Microsoft\Windows\DeliveryOptimization\Cache')
    CrashDumpsMB           = $dumps
    WerMB                  = (Get-PnhSizeMB -Path (Join-Path $env:ProgramData 'Microsoft\Windows\WER\ReportArchive')) + (Get-PnhSizeMB -Path (Join-Path $env:ProgramData 'Microsoft\Windows\WER\ReportQueue'))
    HiberfilMB             = $(if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $hib) { [math]::Round((Get-Item -LiteralPath $hib -Force).Length / 1MB, 0) } else { 0 })
    RecycleBinMB           = Get-PnhSizeMB -Path (Join-Path $sys '$Recycle.Bin')
    WindowsOld             = Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $sys 'Windows.old')
    DownloadsMB            = Get-PnhSizeMB -Path (Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'Downloads')
}

title.de: Alte temporäre Dateien des Benutzers löschen
title.en: Delete old temporary files of the user

explain.de: Löscht temporäre Dateien Ihres Benutzerkontos, die älter als 7 Tage sind. Programme legen sie bei Bedarf neu an. Eine Liste der gelöschten Dateien wird gespeichert.
explain.en: Deletes temporary files of your user account that are older than 7 days. Programs recreate them when needed. A list of the deleted files is kept.

actions.detect: [pscustomobject]@{ Path = [IO.Path]::GetTempPath(); OldFiles = @(Get-PnhFileSafe -Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) -OlderThan (Get-Date).AddDays(-7)).Count; SizeMB = Get-PnhSizeMB -Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) }
actions.run: Remove-PnhOldFile -Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) -Days 7 -ManifestFile (Join-Path $Backup 'deleted.csv') -ProtectedRoot $PnhRoot
actions.rollbackNote: Not reversible: only files in the Temp folder older than 7 days, which programs recreate when needed; links are not followed; the list of deleted files is kept.

title.de: Alte temporäre Dateien von Windows löschen

explain.de: Löscht temporäre Dateien von Windows, die älter als 7 Tage sind. Eine Liste der gelöschten Dateien wird gespeichert.
explain.en: Deletes Windows temporary files that are older than 7 days. A list of the deleted files is kept.

actions.detect: [pscustomobject]@{ OldFiles = @(Get-PnhFileSafe -Path (Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'Temp') -OlderThan (Get-Date).AddDays(-7)).Count; SizeMB = Get-PnhSizeMB -Path (Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'Temp') }
actions.run: Remove-PnhOldFile -Path (Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'Temp') -Days 7 -ManifestFile (Join-Path $Backup 'deleted.csv') -ProtectedRoot $PnhRoot
actions.rollbackNote: Not reversible: same reasoning as disk.clean_user_temp.

explain.de: Leert den Zwischenspeicher, in dem Windows Teile von Updates aufbewahrt. Windows lädt sie bei Bedarf neu herunter.
explain.en: Empties the cache where Windows keeps pieces of updates (Delivery Optimization). Windows downloads them again when needed.

actions.detect: [pscustomobject]@{ CacheMB = Get-PnhSizeMB -Path (Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'ServiceProfiles\NetworkService\AppData\Local\Microsoft\Windows\DeliveryOptimization\Cache') }
actions.run: Delete-DeliveryOptimizationCache -Force
actions.rollbackNote: Not reversible: pure download cache; Windows downloads missing parts again when online.

title.en: Move crash dumps to the rescue drive

explain.de: Verschiebt Absturzberichte von Windows auf die Notfall-SSD. Sie belegen oft viel Platz. Nichts wird gelöscht, sie lassen sich zurückholen.
explain.en: Moves Windows crash dumps to the rescue drive. They often take a lot of space. Nothing is deleted; they can be moved back.

actions.backupNote: Moving is the backup: all files go to the rescue drive with a manifest for the way back.

title.en: Turn off hibernation to free space

explain.de: Schaltet den Ruhezustand aus. Das gibt mehrere Gigabyte frei. Auch der Schnellstart ist danach aus. Lässt sich wieder einschalten.
explain.en: Turns off hibernation. This frees several gigabytes. Fast Startup is also off afterwards. Can be turned on again.

actions.run:
$r = Invoke-PnhNative -FilePath 'powercfg.exe' -ArgumentList @('/hibernate', 'off')
if (-not $r.Ok) { throw ('powercfg exit code ' + $r.ExitCode) }

title.en: Open storage settings and the Recycle Bin

explain.de: Öffnet die Speicher-Einstellungen und den Papierkorb. Dort entscheiden Sie selbst, was weg kann.
explain.en: Opens the storage settings and the Recycle Bin. There you decide yourself what can go.

actions.run:
Start-Process -FilePath 'ms-settings:storagesense'
Start-Process -FilePath 'explorer.exe' -ArgumentList 'shell:RecycleBinFolder'

guide.de: Ich öffne Ihnen die Speicher-Einstellungen und den Papierkorb. Schauen Sie im Papierkorb nach, ob Sie etwas noch brauchen, und leeren Sie ihn dann selbst. In den Einstellungen unter "Temporäre Dateien" können Sie auch "Vorherige Windows-Installation" entfernen, wenn das letzte grosse Update gut läuft.
guide.en: I am opening the storage settings and the Recycle Bin for you. Check the Recycle Bin for anything you still need, then empty it yourself. In Settings under "Temporary files" you can also remove "Previous Windows installation(s)" if the last big update works well.

question.de: Haben Sie den Papierkorb oder die Downloads selbst aufgeräumt?
question.en: Did you clean up the Recycle Bin or Downloads yourself?

title.de: Startdauer und Bremsen beim Start anzeigen
title.en: Show start-up time and what slows it down

explain.de: Liest aus, wie lange der Start dauert und welche Programme, Treiber oder Dienste ihn bremsen. Ändert nichts.
explain.en: Reads how long start-up takes and which programs, drivers or services slow it down. Changes nothing.

actions.experimentalReason: Field names of Diagnostics-Performance events are not confirmed on a test device.

explain.de: Zeigt die Programme, die beim Anmelden automatisch starten. Ändert nichts.
explain.en: Lists the programs that start automatically when you sign in. Changes nothing.

title.en: Stop a program from starting automatically

explain.de: Verhindert, dass ein Programm beim Anmelden automatisch startet, wie im Task-Manager. Das Programm bleibt installiert und lässt sich wieder einschalten.
explain.en: Stops a program from starting automatically at sign-in, like in Task Manager. The program stays installed and can be switched back on.

description.de: Bereich des Autostart-Eintrags (aus der Liste)
description.en: Scope of the startup entry (from the list)

description.de: Art des Autostart-Eintrags (aus der Liste)
description.en: Kind of the startup entry (from the list)

description.de: Name des Autostart-Eintrags aus der Liste
description.en: Startup entry name from the list

actions.backup:
$key = "$($P.Scope):\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\StartupApproved\$($P.Kind)"
$old = (Get-ItemProperty -Path $key -Name $P.Name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).($P.Name)
Write-PnhStateJson -InputObject ([pscustomobject]@{ Key = $key; Name = $P.Name; Old = $(if ($old) { [Convert]::ToBase64String([byte[]]$old) } else { $null }) }) -Path (Join-Path $Backup 'startup.json')
actions.experimentalReason: StartupApproved is not a documented Microsoft interface.

explain.de: Schaltet den Schnellstart aus. Danach ist jedes Herunterfahren ein echter Neustart, was viele Probleme löst. Der Start dauert etwas länger.
explain.en: Turns off Fast Startup. After that every shutdown is a real restart, which solves many problems. Start-up takes a little longer.

actions.detect: [pscustomobject]@{ FastStartup = ((Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Power' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).HiberbootEnabled -eq 1) }
actions.run: Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Power' -Name HiberbootEnabled -Value 0 -Type DWord

explain.de: Zeigt, ob der Druckdienst läuft, welche Drucker es gibt und ob Aufträge hängen. Ändert nichts.
explain.en: Shows whether the print service runs, which printers exist and whether jobs are stuck. Changes nothing.

explain.de: Startet den Druckdienst von Windows neu. Hängende Druckaufträge laufen danach oft wieder.
explain.en: Restarts the Windows print service. Stuck print jobs often continue afterwards.

actions.detect: Get-Service -Name Spooler | Select-Object @{ n = 'Status'; e = { "$($_.Status)" } }, @{ n = 'StartType'; e = { "$($_.StartType)" } }
actions.run:
if ("$((Get-Service -Name Spooler).StartType)" -eq 'Disabled') { throw 'The print spooler is disabled (possibly on purpose); not changing it' }
Restart-Service -Name Spooler -Force
actions.backupNote: No setting is changed.
actions.rollbackNote: Not needed.

explain.de: Nimmt alle wartenden Druckaufträge aus der Warteschlange und legt sie auf der Notfall-SSD ab. Danach müssen Sie neu drucken.
explain.en: Takes all waiting print jobs out of the queue and keeps them on the rescue drive. You need to print again afterwards.

actions.detect: [pscustomobject]@{ SpoolFiles = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'System32\spool\PRINTERS') -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Count }
actions.backupNote: The spool files are moved to the rescue drive, not deleted.

explain.de: Schaltet "Drucker offline verwenden" aus, damit Windows wieder an den Drucker sendet.
explain.en: Turns off "Use printer offline" so Windows sends jobs to the printer again.

description.de: Name des Druckers aus der Erkennung

actions.detect: Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_Printer | Where-Object { $_.WorkOffline } | Select-Object Name, Default, PortName
actions.experimentalReason: Writing Win32_Printer.WorkOffline via CIM is not confirmed on a test device.

explain.de: Macht den gewählten Drucker zum Standarddrucker, damit Ausdrucke dort landen.
explain.en: Makes the chosen printer the default so prints go there.

description.de: Name des Druckers aus der Erkennung

actions.detect: Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_Printer | Select-Object Name, Default, WorkOffline, Network

explain.de: Prüft Lautsprecher, Kopfhörer, Lautstärke und Stummschaltung. Ändert nichts.
explain.en: Checks speakers, headphones, volume and mute. Changes nothing.

explain.de: Startet die Windows-Dienste für den Ton neu.
explain.en: Restarts the Windows sound services.

actions.detect: Get-Service -Name Audiosrv, AudioEndpointBuilder | Select-Object Name, @{ n = 'Status'; e = { "$($_.Status)" } }, @{ n = 'StartType'; e = { "$($_.StartType)" } }
actions.run:
Restart-Service -Name AudioEndpointBuilder -Force
Start-Service -Name Audiosrv
actions.backupNote: No setting is changed.
actions.rollbackNote: Not needed.

title.en: Unmute and turn the volume up

explain.de: Hebt die Stummschaltung auf und stellt die Lautstärke auf die Hälfte, wenn sie sehr leise ist.
explain.en: Unmutes the sound and raises the volume to half if it is very low.

actions.detect: Get-PnhAudioState

explain.de: Startet das Tongerät neu, wenn Windows einen Fehler bei ihm meldet.
explain.en: Restarts the sound device when Windows reports a problem with it.

description.de: Geräte-ID (InstanceId) aus der Erkennung

actions.detect: Get-PnpDevice -Class MEDIA, AudioEndpoint -PresentOnly -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object FriendlyName, @{ n = 'Status'; e = { "$($_.Status)" } }, ConfigManagerErrorCode, InstanceId

title.en: Check the graphics adapter and monitors

explain.de: Zeigt Grafikkarte, Treiber, Auflösung und ob der Grafiktreiber kürzlich abgestürzt ist. Ändert nichts.
explain.en: Shows the graphics adapter, driver, resolution and whether the graphics driver crashed recently. Changes nothing.

title.en: Refresh the screen with a key combination

explain.de: Erklärt eine Tastenkombination, die den Grafiktreiber neu startet, wenn das Bild schwarz oder eingefroren ist.
explain.en: Explains a key combination that restarts the graphics driver when the screen is black or frozen.

actions.run: [pscustomobject]@{ Guide = $true }

guide.de: Drücken Sie gleichzeitig die Windows-Taste, Strg, Umschalt (Pfeil nach oben) und B. Der Bildschirm wird kurz schwarz und es piept. Ihre offenen Programme bleiben offen.
guide.en: Press the Windows key, Ctrl, Shift and B at the same time. The screen goes black for a moment and you hear a beep. Your open programs stay open.

question.en: Is the picture back to normal?

explain.de: Startet die Grafikkarte neu. Der Bildschirm ist dabei einige Sekunden schwarz. Spiele und Grafikprogramme vorher schliessen.
explain.en: Restarts the graphics adapter. The screen is black for a few seconds. Close games and graphics programs first.

description.de: Geräte-ID (InstanceId) aus der Erkennung

actions.detect: Get-PnpDevice -Class Display -PresentOnly -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object FriendlyName, @{ n = 'Status'; e = { "$($_.Status)" } }, ConfigManagerErrorCode, InstanceId
actions.run:
$r = Invoke-PnhNative -FilePath 'pnputil.exe' -ArgumentList @('/restart-device', $P.InstanceId) -OkExitCodes @(0, 3010)
if (-not $r.Ok) { throw ('pnputil /restart-device exit code ' + $r.ExitCode) }
actions.rollbackNote: Not needed; if the screen stays black, a restart helps (sys.restart).

explain.de: Zeigt Geräte, bei denen Windows einen Fehler meldet, wie im Geräte-Manager. Ändert nichts.
explain.en: Lists devices that Windows reports a problem with, like Device Manager does. Changes nothing.

actions.run:
Get-PnpDevice -PresentOnly -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { "$($_.Status)" -ne 'OK' -and $_.ConfigManagerErrorCode -ne 0 } |
    Select-Object -First 25 FriendlyName, Class, @{ n = 'Status'; e = { "$($_.Status)" } }, ConfigManagerErrorCode, InstanceId

title.en: Switch a disabled device back on

explain.de: Schaltet ein Gerät wieder ein, das in Windows deaktiviert wurde. Kamera oder Mikrofon können absichtlich aus sein.
explain.en: Switches a device back on that was disabled in Windows. A camera or microphone may have been switched off on purpose.

description.de: Geräte-ID (InstanceId) aus der Erkennung

actions.detect: Get-PnpDevice -PresentOnly -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.ConfigManagerErrorCode -eq 22 } | Select-Object FriendlyName, Class, InstanceId
actions.run: Enable-PnpDevice -InstanceId $P.InstanceId -Confirm:$false

explain.de: Startet ein Gerät neu, das einen Fehler meldet. Oft hilft auch einfach aus- und wieder einstecken.
explain.en: Restarts a device that reports an error. Unplugging it and plugging it back in often helps too.

description.de: Geräte-ID (InstanceId) aus der Erkennung

actions.detect: Get-PnpDevice -PresentOnly -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { @(10, 43) -contains $_.ConfigManagerErrorCode } | Select-Object FriendlyName, Class, ConfigManagerErrorCode, InstanceId
actions.rollbackNote: Not needed.

title.en: Check the time and time zone

explain.de: Prüft, ob Uhrzeit, Zeitzone und automatische Zeiteinstellung stimmen. Ändert nichts.
explain.en: Checks whether the time, the time zone and automatic time are right. Changes nothing.

actions.run:
$w = Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\W32Time\Parameters' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
$newest = Get-WinEvent -LogName System -MaxEvents 1 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
$svc = Get-Service -Name W32Time -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
[pscustomobject]@{
    Local               = (Get-Date).ToString('s')
    Utc                 = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('s')
    TimeZone            = (Get-TimeZone).Id
    BeforeToolBuild     = ((Get-Date) -lt $PnhBuildDate)
    NewestEventInFuture = [bool]($newest -and $newest.TimeCreated -gt (Get-Date).AddMinutes(10))
    NtpType             = $w.Type
    NtpServer           = $w.NtpServer
    W32Time             = "$($svc.Status)/$($svc.StartType)"
    Domain              = (Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_ComputerSystem).PartOfDomain
}

explain.de: Stellt die Zeitzone ein, wenn die Uhr um ganze Stunden falsch geht.
explain.en: Sets the time zone when the clock is off by whole hours.

description.de: Zeitzonen-ID aus der Kandidatenliste
description.en: Time zone ID from the candidate list

actions.detect:
$cur = Get-TimeZone
$cand = @(Get-TimeZone -ListAvailable | Where-Object { [math]::Abs(($_.BaseUtcOffset - $cur.BaseUtcOffset).TotalHours) -le 3 } |
        Sort-Object { [math]::Abs(($_.BaseUtcOffset - $cur.BaseUtcOffset).TotalHours) } | Select-Object -First 30 | ForEach-Object { $_.Id })
[pscustomobject]@{ Current = $cur.Id; Candidates = $cand }
actions.run:
if (-not (Get-TimeZone -ListAvailable | Where-Object { $_.Id -eq $P.TimeZoneId })) { throw 'Unknown time zone' }
Set-TimeZone -Id $P.TimeZoneId

explain.de: Schaltet die automatische Uhrzeit wieder ein. Die Uhr wird gestellt, sobald Internet da ist.
explain.en: Turns automatic time back on. The clock is set as soon as there is internet.

explain.de: Stellt die Uhr auf die Zeit, die Sie angeben, zum Beispiel vom Handy abgelesen.
explain.en: Sets the clock to the time you give, for example read from your phone.

description.de: Richtige lokale Zeit vom Benutzer, z. B. 2026-11-09T21:30
description.en: Correct local time given by the user, e.g. 2026-11-09T21:30

actions.detect: [pscustomobject]@{ Local = (Get-Date).ToString('s'); TimeZone = (Get-TimeZone).Id }
actions.run:
$t = [datetime]::ParseExact($P.DateTimeIso, @('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm', 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss'), [Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture, [Globalization.DateTimeStyles]::None)
Set-Date -Date $t | Out-Null
actions.rollbackNote: Not useful: restoring a wrong time never helps. The time can be set again at any time; with internet the time service corrects it.

explain.de: Zeigt, ob der Virenschutz läuft, wie alt seine Virenliste ist und ob er etwas gefunden hat. Ändert nichts.
explain.en: Shows whether antivirus protection runs, how old its virus definitions are and whether it found anything. Changes nothing.

actions.run:
$mp = Get-MpComputerStatus
$pol = @(Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender', 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Real-Time Protection' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
[pscustomobject]@{
    RunningMode      = "$($mp.AMRunningMode)"
    ServiceEnabled   = $mp.AMServiceEnabled
    AntivirusEnabled = $mp.AntivirusEnabled
    RealTime         = $mp.RealTimeProtectionEnabled
    SignatureVersion = $mp.AntivirusSignatureVersion
    SignatureAgeDays = $mp.AntivirusSignatureAge
    TamperProtected  = $mp.IsTamperProtected
    QuickScanAgeDays = $mp.QuickScanAge
    PolicyDisabled   = [bool]($pol | Where-Object { $_.DisableAntiSpyware -eq 1 -or $_.DisableRealtimeMonitoring -eq 1 })
    OtherAv          = @(Get-CimInstance -Namespace 'root/SecurityCenter2' -ClassName AntiVirusProduct -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.displayName -notmatch 'Defender' } | ForEach-Object { $_.displayName })
    Threats30d       = @(Get-MpThreatDetection -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.InitialDetectionTime -gt (Get-Date).AddDays(-30) } | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{ When = $_.InitialDetectionTime.ToString('s'); ThreatId = $_.ThreatID; Success = $_.ActionSuccess; Resources = @($_.Resources | Select-Object -First 3) } })
    SsdPackage       = Get-PnhDefenderPackage -Root $PnhRoot
}

title.en: Update virus definitions from the rescue drive

explain.de: Spielt eine neuere Virenliste von Microsoft ein, die auf der Notfall-SSD liegt. Funktioniert ohne Internet.
explain.en: Installs newer Microsoft virus definitions that are stored on the rescue drive. Works without internet.

actions.detect:
$pkg = Get-PnhDefenderPackage -Root $PnhRoot
[pscustomobject]@{ Installed = (Get-MpComputerStatus).AntivirusSignatureVersion; Package = $pkg.Version; PackageSignatureOk = $pkg.SignatureOk }
actions.rollbackNote: Deliberately none: older definitions would weaken protection.

explain.de: Schaltet den Echtzeitschutz von Microsoft Defender wieder ein, wenn kein anderes Schutzprogramm aktiv ist.
explain.en: Turns Microsoft Defender real-time protection back on when no other security program is active.

actions.detect:
$mp = Get-MpComputerStatus
[pscustomobject]@{ Mode = "$($mp.AMRunningMode)"; RealTime = $mp.RealTimeProtectionEnabled; PolicyDisabled = [bool]((Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Real-Time Protection' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).DisableRealtimeMonitoring -eq 1) }
actions.backupNote: None needed: the action only raises protection.
actions.rollbackNote: Deliberately none: it would switch protection off.

explain.de: Lässt Microsoft Defender die wichtigsten Stellen nach Schadsoftware durchsuchen. Dauert etwa 5 bis 20 Minuten.
explain.en: Lets Microsoft Defender scan the most important places for malware. Takes about 5 to 20 minutes.

actions.detect: [pscustomobject]@{ Mode = "$((Get-MpComputerStatus).AMRunningMode)"; QuickScanEnd = (Get-MpComputerStatus).QuickScanEndTime }
actions.run: Start-MpScan -ScanType QuickScan
actions.backupNote: None; Defender puts findings into quarantine, where they can be restored.
actions.rollbackNote: Found files are in Defender quarantine and can be restored in Windows Security > Protection history.

explain.de: Startet den Computer neu und sucht ausserhalb von Windows nach versteckter Schadsoftware. Dauert etwa 15 Minuten. Vorher alles speichern.
explain.en: Restarts the computer and searches for hidden malware outside of Windows. Takes about 15 minutes. Save your work first.

actions.detect: [pscustomobject]@{ Mode = "$((Get-MpComputerStatus).AMRunningMode)"; SignatureAgeDays = (Get-MpComputerStatus).AntivirusSignatureAge }
actions.run: Start-MpWDOScan
actions.backupNote: None; Defender puts findings into quarantine, where they can be restored.
actions.rollbackNote: Found files are in Defender quarantine and can be restored in Windows Security > Protection history.

title.en: Quick check of the Windows component store

explain.de: Prüft schnell, ob der Speicher mit den Original-Dateien von Windows beschädigt ist. Ändert nichts.
explain.en: Quickly checks whether the store of original Windows files is damaged. Changes nothing.

actions.run: Repair-WindowsImage -Online -CheckHealth | Select-Object @{ n = 'ImageHealthState'; e = { "$($_.ImageHealthState)" } }, RestartNeeded

title.en: Thorough check of the Windows component store

explain.de: Prüft gründlich, ob der Speicher mit den Original-Dateien von Windows beschädigt ist. Dauert bis zu 30 Minuten. Ändert nichts.
explain.en: Thoroughly checks whether the store of original Windows files is damaged. Takes up to 30 minutes. Changes nothing.

actions.run: Repair-WindowsImage -Online -ScanHealth | Select-Object @{ n = 'ImageHealthState'; e = { "$($_.ImageHealthState)" } }, RestartNeeded

title.en: Check and repair Windows system files

explain.de: Prüft die Systemdateien von Windows und ersetzt beschädigte durch die Originale. Dauert 10 bis 30 Minuten.
explain.en: Checks the Windows system files and replaces damaged ones with the originals. Takes 10 to 30 minutes.

actions.detect: [pscustomobject]@{ ImageHealth = "$((Repair-WindowsImage -Online -CheckHealth).ImageHealthState)" }
actions.run:
$r = Invoke-PnhNative -FilePath (Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'System32\sfc.exe') -ArgumentList @('/scannow')
$r.ExitCode
actions.backupNote: The restore point created before the first change. SFC only replaces damaged system files with the originals.
actions.rollbackNote: Not reversible file by file: only files that differ from the original are replaced; the restore point is the overall way back.

title.de: Komponentenspeicher mit Windows-Abbild von der SSD reparieren
title.en: Repair the component store from an image on the rescue drive

explain.de: Repariert den Speicher mit den Original-Dateien von Windows aus einem Windows-Abbild auf der Notfall-SSD. Dauert bis zu einer Stunde.
explain.en: Repairs the store of original Windows files using a Windows image on the rescue drive. Takes up to an hour.

description.de: Pfad des Windows-Abbilds aus der Erkennung
Index im Windows-Abbild aus der Erkennung

actions.run:
$kind = $(if ($P.SourcePath -like '*.esd') { 'esd' } else { 'wim' })
$src = '/Source:{0}:{1}:{2}' -f $kind, $P.SourcePath, $P.Index
$r = Invoke-PnhNative -FilePath 'dism.exe' -ArgumentList @('/Online', '/Cleanup-Image', '/RestoreHealth', $src, '/LimitAccess', '/NoRestart') -OkExitCodes @(0, 3010)
if (-not $r.Ok) { throw ('DISM exit code ' + $r.ExitCode + ' (0x800f081f = source files do not match)') }
actions.backupNote: The restore point created before the first change.
actions.rollbackNote: Not reversible piece by piece: damaged components are replaced by originals; the restore point is the overall way back.

title.en: Restart the taskbar and File Explorer

explain.de: Startet Taskleiste, Desktop und Explorer neu. Offene Explorer-Fenster schliessen sich, Ihre Programme bleiben offen.

Stop-Process -Name ShellExperienceHost -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
actions.backupNote: No setting is changed.
actions.rollbackNote: Not needed; Windows restarts the processes itself.

explain.de: Startet die Suche in der Taskleiste neu, wenn sie nicht reagiert.
explain.en: Restarts search in the taskbar when it does not respond.

actions.run: Stop-Process -Name SearchHost, SearchApp, SearchUI -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
actions.backupNote: No setting is changed.
actions.rollbackNote: Not needed; search restarts the next time it is opened.

explain.de: Meldet das Startmenü bei Windows neu an. Nur, wenn ein Neustart des Startmenüs nicht geholfen hat.
explain.en: Registers the Start menu with Windows again. Only if restarting the Start menu did not help.

actions.detect: @('Microsoft.Windows.StartMenuExperienceHost', 'Microsoft.Windows.ShellExperienceHost') | ForEach-Object { Get-AppxPackage -Name $_ } | Select-Object Name, Version, @{ n = 'Status'; e = { "$($_.Status)" } }, InstallLocation
actions.backupNote: The restore point created before the first change; the installed package is registered again from its own folder.
actions.rollbackNote: The same version is registered again; the restore point is the overall way back.
actions.experimentalReason: Common community fix; Microsoft's own guide does not recommend it.

explain.de: Zeigt Apps aus dem Microsoft Store, die Windows als beschädigt meldet. Ändert nichts.
explain.en: Lists Microsoft Store apps that Windows reports as broken. Changes nothing.

explain.de: Meldet eine App bei Windows neu an, wenn sie nicht mehr startet. Die Daten der App bleiben erhalten.
explain.en: Registers an app with Windows again when it no longer starts. The app's data is kept.

description.de: Paketname der App aus der Erkennung

actions.detect: Get-AppxPackage -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { -not $_.IsFramework } | Select-Object Name, @{ n = 'Status'; e = { "$($_.Status)" } } | Sort-Object Name
actions.backupNote: No data is affected: the installed version is registered again (app data stays).
actions.rollbackNote: The same version is registered again; nothing is replaced.

explain.de: Leert den Zwischenspeicher des Microsoft Store. Danach öffnet sich der Store. Ohne Internet zeigt er nur eine Fehlerseite.
explain.en: Clears the Microsoft Store cache. The Store opens afterwards. Without internet it only shows an error page.

actions.detect: [pscustomobject]@{ StoreInstalled = [bool](Get-AppxPackage -Name 'Microsoft.WindowsStore' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) }
actions.run:
$r = Invoke-PnhNative -FilePath (Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'System32\wsreset.exe') -TimeoutSeconds 120
Write-PnhStateJson -InputObject ([pscustomobject]@{ ExitCode = $r.ExitCode }) -Path (Join-Path $Backup 'result.json')
actions.backupNote: None (cache only).
actions.rollbackNote: Not reversible: only the Store cache is cleared, which is reloaded.

explain.de: Prüft, ob Windows Sie mit einem vorübergehenden Profil angemeldet hat (Desktop plötzlich leer). Ändert nichts.
explain.en: Checks whether Windows signed you in with a temporary profile (desktop suddenly empty). Changes nothing.

explain.de: Legt den Ordner für temporäre Dateien wieder an, wenn er fehlt. Programme brauchen ihn zum Installieren.
explain.en: Creates the folder for temporary files again when it is missing. Programs need it to install.

actions.detect: [pscustomobject]@{ TempPath = [IO.Path]::GetTempPath(); Exists = (Test-Path -LiteralPath ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath())) }
actions.run:
$t = [IO.Path]::GetTempPath()
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $t)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $t -Force | Out-Null }

explain.de: Verbindet Ihr altes Benutzerprofil wieder mit Ihrem Konto, wenn Windows Sie nur mit einem vorübergehenden Profil anmeldet. Danach ist ein Neustart nötig.
explain.en: Reconnects your original user profile when Windows only signs you in with a temporary profile. A restart is needed afterwards.

description.de: Konto-ID (SID) aus der Erkennung

actions.run:
$pl = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\ProfileList'
$sid = $P.Sid
$bak = Join-Path $pl ($sid + '.bak')
$cur = Join-Path $pl $sid
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $bak)) { throw 'No .bak entry for this SID' }
$bakPath = (Get-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $bak).ProfileImagePath
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $bakPath 'NTUSER.DAT'))) { throw 'The old profile has no NTUSER.DAT; stopping' }
$ts = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMddHHmmss'
$parked = ''
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $cur) { $parked = $sid + '.pnh-' + $ts; Rename-Item -LiteralPath $cur -NewName $parked }
Rename-Item -LiteralPath $bak -NewName $sid
Set-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $cur -Name RefCount -Value 0 -Type DWord
Set-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $cur -Name State -Value 0 -Type DWord
Write-PnhStateJson -InputObject ([pscustomobject]@{ Sid = $sid; Parked = $parked }) -Path (Join-Path $Backup 'renamed.json')

explain.de: Prüft, ob die Festplatten gesund sind, und zählt Fehler der letzten Tage. Ändert nichts.
explain.en: Checks whether the disks are healthy and counts recent disk errors. Changes nothing.

explain.de: Prüft Laufwerk C: im laufenden Betrieb auf Fehler im Dateisystem. Ändert nichts, merkt Fehler nur zur Reparatur vor.
explain.en: Scans drive C: for file system errors while Windows runs. Changes nothing; it only notes errors for a later repair.

actions.detect: Get-Volume -DriveLetter ($env:SystemDrive.TrimEnd(':')) | Select-Object @{ n = 'Health'; e = { "$($_.HealthStatus)" } }, @{ n = 'Operational'; e = { "$($_.OperationalStatus)" } }
actions.run:
$res = Repair-Volume -DriveLetter ($env:SystemDrive.TrimEnd(':')) -Scan
Write-PnhStateJson -InputObject ([pscustomobject]@{ Result = "$res" }) -Path (Join-Path $Backup 'result.json')
"$res"
actions.backupNote: Not needed: the scan changes nothing.
actions.rollbackNote: Changes nothing on the file system.

title.de: Laufwerk C: beim nächsten Start reparieren
title.en: Repair drive C: at the next restart

explain.de: Lässt Windows das Laufwerk C: beim nächsten Neustart reparieren. Das kann lange dauern. Vorher wichtige Dateien sichern.
explain.en: Lets Windows repair drive C: at the next restart. This can take a long time. Back up important files first.

actions.backupNote: No copy is possible. The user should back up important files first.
actions.rollbackNote: Deliberately none: the repair at restart cannot be undone, and excluding the drive from the check (chkntfs /x) would stay in place permanently.

explain.de: Prüft, ob Laufwerk C: verschlüsselt ist. Der Schlüssel selbst wird nie angezeigt. Ändert nichts.
explain.en: Checks whether drive C: is encrypted. The key itself is never shown. Changes nothing.

actions.run:
$b = Get-BitLockerVolume -MountPoint $env:SystemDrive
[pscustomobject]@{
    VolumeStatus = "$($b.VolumeStatus)"
    Protection   = "$($b.ProtectionStatus)"
    Percent      = $b.EncryptionPercentage
    Method       = "$($b.EncryptionMethod)"
    Protectors   = @($b.KeyProtector | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{ Type = "$($_.KeyProtectorType)"; Id = $_.KeyProtectorId } })
}

title.en: Show where to find the recovery key

explain.de: Erklärt, wo Sie den Wiederherstellungsschlüssel für die Verschlüsselung finden. Der Schlüssel selbst wird nie angezeigt.
explain.en: Explains where to find the recovery key for drive encryption. The key itself is never shown.

actions.run:
$rp = (Get-BitLockerVolume -MountPoint $env:SystemDrive).KeyProtector | Where-Object { "$($_.KeyProtectorType)" -eq 'RecoveryPassword' } | Select-Object -First 1
[pscustomobject]@{ KeyIdShort = $(if ($rp) { "$($rp.KeyProtectorId)".Trim('{}').Substring(0, 8) } else { '?' }) }

guide.de: Ihr Laufwerk ist verschlüsselt. Für den Notfall brauchen Sie den Wiederherstellungsschlüssel. Öffnen Sie auf Ihrem Handy aka.ms/myrecoverykey, melden Sie sich mit Ihrem Microsoft-Konto an und suchen Sie den Schlüssel, dessen ID mit {KeyIdShort} beginnt. Schreiben Sie ihn auf Papier. Tippen Sie ihn nicht hier ein.
guide.en: Your drive is encrypted. In an emergency you need the recovery key. On your phone, open aka.ms/myrecoverykey, sign in with your Microsoft account and look for the key whose ID starts with {KeyIdShort}. Write it down on paper. Do not type it in here.

question.de: Haben Sie den Schlüssel gefunden und aufgeschrieben?
question.en: Did you find the key and write it down?

title.en: Most frequent errors in Event Viewer

explain.de: Fasst die häufigsten Fehlermeldungen von Windows der letzten zwei Wochen zusammen. Ändert nichts.
explain.en: Summarizes the most frequent Windows error messages of the last two weeks. Changes nothing.

explain.de: Zeigt Abstürze, Bluescreens und abgestürzte Programme der letzten 30 Tage. Ändert nichts.
explain.en: Shows crashes, blue screens and crashed programs of the last 30 days. Changes nothing.

actions.run:
$since = (Get-Date).AddDays(-30)
[pscustomobject]@{
    BugChecks     = @(Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{ LogName = 'System'; ProviderName = 'Microsoft-Windows-WER-SystemErrorReporting'; Id = 1001; StartTime = $since } -MaxEvents 20 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { "$($_.TimeCreated.ToString('s')) $($_.Properties[0].Value)" })
    KernelPower41 = @(Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{ LogName = 'System'; ProviderName = 'Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-Power'; Id = 41; StartTime = $since } -MaxEvents 20 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { "$($_.TimeCreated.ToString('s')) bugcheck=$($_.Properties[0].Value)" })
    Whea          = @(Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{ LogName = 'System'; ProviderName = 'Microsoft-Windows-WHEA-Logger'; StartTime = $since } -MaxEvents 50 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Group-Object Id | ForEach-Object { "$($_.Name) x$($_.Count)" })
    AppCrashes    = @(Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{ LogName = 'Application'; ProviderName = 'Application Error'; Id = 1000; StartTime = $since } -MaxEvents 300 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Group-Object { $_.Properties[0].Value } | Sort-Object Count -Descending | Select-Object -First 10 | ForEach-Object { "$($_.Name) x$($_.Count)" })
}

explain.de: Zeigt zeitlich geordnet, was in den letzten zwei Wochen installiert wurde und was abgestürzt ist. Ändert nichts.
explain.en: Shows in time order what was installed and what crashed in the last two weeks. Changes nothing.

actions.run:
$since = [Management.ManagementDateTimeConverter]::ToDmtfDateTime((Get-Date).AddDays(-14))
Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_ReliabilityRecords -Filter ("TimeGenerated > '" + $since + "'") -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
    Sort-Object TimeGenerated -Descending | Select-Object -First 40 |
    ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{ Time = $_.TimeGenerated.ToString('s'); Source = $_.SourceName; Id = $_.EventIdentifier; Product = $_.ProductName } }
